entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling because I'd like to make a return for a helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the Pro-Lid helmet. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The product itself is fine, I'm sure the safety features are top-notch, but the color wasn't quite what I expected from the website photos.
I see. And has the helmet been used at all?
Not at all. The box is still unopened, actually. It's been sitting here waiting for me to get around to calling.

Understood. I see here the order was delivered about 58 days ago. Let me just check our return policy for you... Okay, it looks like you're good to go. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery.
Excellent. I'm glad to hear that.

Yes, I can go ahead and approve this return right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.

That's great, thank you. Now, since the box is unopened and it's a simple color issue, I was wondering if you might be able to offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order another helmet in a different color right away.

I appreciate you asking, and I'm happy you're sticking with VeloFit for your gear. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for this type of return. However, the pre-paid shipping label is all set for you, so there will be no cost on your end to send it back.
Okay, that's fair. The free return shipping helps. I appreciate you processing this so quickly.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
